answer: Per-agent stake bonds blunt Sybil swarms: every identity must lock capital that is slashed when its work proves fake, so ten thousand puppets cost real money instead of a scripted afternoon. An honest operator sees that deposit as a narrow canyon, costly to enter and slow to widen. A scammer needs volume, and each clone pays the same toll, draining the ledger like water into sand. Reputation then compounds on the survivors, an oasis where subsidised compute and paying counterparties gather. Cheap breadth becomes the punishable act, sharp as saffron by weight.
